sections.body: A FACT is something we can check and prove is true. 'A week has seven days.'
An OPINION is what someone thinks or feels. 'Mondays are boring.' Others may disagree!
Clue words for opinions: best, worst, beautiful, boring, I think, I feel.
Opinions are fine to have. But it's good to know when something is an opinion.
Say one fact and one opinion about your favourite animal.
Model it during the day: 'That's my opinion, you might disagree!' This builds respect for different views.

hints: 'The sun is hot' is a fact. 'Summer is the best season' is an opinion. Find the fact.
quiz.explain: You can check that dogs have four legs. It's a fact.

options: Football is the most fun sport.
Football is played with a ball.
hints: Look for clue words like 'most fun'.
'Pizza is yummy' is an opinion. Some people don't like pizza!
quiz.explain: Some people prefer other sports, so 'most fun' is an opinion.

quiz.q: 'I think spinach is yucky.' This is…
hints: Look at the first two words.
'I think' tells you it's what someone feels.
'I feel happy today' tells us about a feeling. Is that something we can prove?
quiz.explain: 'I think' shows it's an opinion. Other people like spinach!
